reason: I need clients, and this is the first one of these that talks about meetings instead of a strategy deck. The 15 companies cost me a 30-minute call, and I only pay after three free meetings, so I'll do the free list and start the pilot if the names are real.
objection: I've had agencies book me 'meetings' with juniors who wanted a price list for their files. One logistics client getting 45 meetings tells me nothing. And it's my name on the messages, so if they send spam in my name, I lose more than 900 euros.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 companies are names I already know or obviously wrong for us, or if the first three free meetings turn out to be tyre-kickers, I stop right there.
